examples.text_en: The room was hot and he would drowse in class.
examples.text_zh: 房间很热，他上课时会打瞌睡。

examples.text_en: He will often drowse at the table in the morning.
examples.text_zh: 他早上常坐在桌边打瞌睡。

examples.text_en: The long meeting gave me a strong drowsiness.
examples.text_zh: 漫长的会议让我困得厉害。

examples.text_en: A deep drowsiness came over him at the table.
examples.text_zh: 他坐在桌边时，一阵浓重的睡意袭来。

examples.text_en: Both men tried to drub him in the street.
examples.text_zh: 那两个男人想在街上痛打他。

examples.text_en: They drub the idea into the children day after day.
examples.text_zh: 他们日复一日地把这个观念硬灌给孩子。

examples.text_en: The duckling followed its mother into the cold water.
examples.text_zh: 小鸭子跟着妈妈走进冰冷的水里。

examples.text_en: A small duckling was lost near the old road.
examples.text_zh: 一只小鸭子在老路附近走失了。

examples.text_en: The air comes into the room through a long duct.
examples.text_zh: 空气通过一条长长的管道进入房间。

examples.text_en: A large duct moves the hot air out of the house.
examples.text_zh: 一条大管道把热空气送出屋外。

examples.text_en: Gold is very ductile and easy to work with.
examples.text_zh: 黄金很有韧性，容易加工。

examples.text_en: The young teacher found the boy easy and ductile.
examples.text_zh: 这位年轻老师发现那个男孩听话又好教。

examples.text_en: Both friends played a duet at the school.
examples.text_zh: 两个朋友在学校演奏了一首二重奏。

examples.text_en: We heard a beautiful duet from the girls.
examples.text_zh: 我们听到女孩们唱了一首优美的二重唱。

examples.text_en: The duke lived in a great house near the sea.
examples.text_zh: 公爵住在海边一座很大的房子里。

examples.text_en: A young duke came to the city with his men.
examples.text_zh: 一位年轻的公爵带着随从来到城里。

examples.text_en: Her dulcet voice made everyone feel at home.
examples.text_zh: 她悦耳的嗓音让每个人都感到自在。

examples.text_en: The dulcet sounds of the song put the child to sleep.
examples.text_zh: 那首歌悦耳的声音让孩子睡着了。

examples.text_en: The dullard could not answer even one simple question.
examples.text_zh: 这个笨蛋连一个简单的问题都答不上来。

examples.text_en: They called him a dullard behind his back.
examples.text_zh: 他们在他背后叫他笨蛋。

examples.text_en: He looked at me dully and said nothing at all.
examples.text_zh: 他迟钝地看了我一眼，什么也没说。

examples.text_en: The old man talked dully about the long past days.
examples.text_zh: 老人迟钝地讲着那些久远的往事。

examples.text_en: The note was duly sent to the right office.
examples.text_zh: 这张便条已按时送到正确的办公室。

examples.text_en: He duly arrived at the meeting and took his place.
examples.text_zh: 他准时到达会场，在自己的位置坐下。

examples.text_en: The news seemed to dumbfound the whole small town.
examples.text_zh: 这个消息似乎让整个小镇的人都惊呆了。

examples.text_en: Her answer would dumbfound even the best teacher.
examples.text_zh: 她的回答连最好的老师都会目瞪口呆。

examples.text_en: The boy felt like a dunce in front of them.
examples.text_zh: 那男孩在他们面前觉得自己像个傻瓜。

examples.text_en: They called the poor dunce names at school.
examples.text_zh: 他们在学校给这个可怜的傻瓜起外号。

examples.text_en: We walked over the high dune near the sea.
examples.text_zh: 我们走过海边那座高高的沙丘。

examples.text_en: A small house stood on the old dune.
examples.text_zh: 一座小房子矗立在古老的沙丘上。

examples.text_en: The poor man was kept in a dark dungeon.
examples.text_zh: 这个可怜的人被关在一座黑暗的地牢里。

examples.text_en: They found a long dungeon under the old house.
examples.text_zh: 他们在老房子下面发现了一条长长的地牢通道。

examples.text_en: His duplicitous words made everyone question him.
examples.text_zh: 他两面三刀的话让大家都对他起了疑心。

examples.text_en: The duplicitous man was never true to his friends.
examples.text_zh: 这个奸诈的人对朋友从不真心。

examples.text_en: Her duplicity became clear to all of us.
examples.text_zh: 她的口是心非我们大家都看清楚了。

examples.text_en: He was known for duplicity and hard words.
examples.text_zh: 他以口是心非和言辞刻薄而出名。

examples.text_en: These shoes are strong and durable for long walks.
examples.text_zh: 这双鞋结实耐用，适合长途行走。

examples.text_en: We need a durable plan for this old problem.
examples.text_zh: 我们需要一个长久可行的办法来解决这个老问题。

examples.text_en: The duration of the meeting was hard to guess.
examples.text_zh: 会议要开多久很难说。

examples.text_en: We must stay here for the duration of the game.
examples.text_zh: 比赛期间我们必须一直待在这里。

examples.text_en: He signed the note under duress and said nothing.
examples.text_zh: 他在胁迫下签了字，什么也没说。

examples.text_en: The court heard that her words came under duress.
examples.text_zh: 法庭得知她的话是受胁迫说出的。

examples.text_en: The room grew dusky as the day came to an end.
examples.text_zh: 天色将晚，房间渐渐暗了下来。

examples.text_en: We saw a dusky figure near the old wall.
examples.text_zh: 我们在老墙附近看到一个暗淡的身影。

examples.text_en: He put the old paper into the dustbin.
examples.text_zh: 他把旧报纸扔进了垃圾箱。

examples.text_en: The dustbin near the door was full again.
examples.text_zh: 门边的垃圾箱又满了。

examples.text_en: The old room was dark and very dusty.
examples.text_zh: 那个老房间又黑又满是灰尘。

examples.text_en: His shoes were dusty after the long walk.
examples.text_zh: 走了很长的路后，他的鞋上落满了灰。

examples.text_en: The dutiful son came home to help his mother.
examples.text_zh: 这个孝顺的儿子回家帮母亲干活。

examples.text_en: She was a dutiful daughter and a good friend.
examples.text_zh: 她是个孝顺的女儿，也是个好朋友。

examples.text_en: Their old dwelling stood at the end of the road.
examples.text_zh: 他们的旧住处位于这条路的尽头。

examples.text_en: We found a small dwelling near the green field.
examples.text_zh: 我们在绿色的田野附近发现了一处小小的住所。

examples.text_en: The food began to dwindle after the long week.
examples.text_zh: 过了漫长的一周，食物开始减少。

examples.text_en: The small group would dwindle to a few people.
examples.text_zh: 这个小团体后来缩小到只剩几个人。

examples.text_en: The city is a dynamic place for young people.
examples.text_zh: 这座城市对年轻人来说是个充满活力的地方。

examples.text_en: She has a dynamic way of doing her work.
examples.text_zh: 她做事自有一套充满活力的方式。

examples.text_en: The dynamical system can change with the least force.
examples.text_zh: 这个动力系统只需最小的力就能改变。

examples.text_en: The dynamical parts of the system are hard to see.
examples.text_zh: 这个系统的动力部分很难看清。

examples.text_en: He studies the dynamics of the whole system.
examples.text_zh: 他研究整个系统的动力学。

examples.text_en: He can show the dynamics of this simple system.
examples.text_zh: 他能说明这个简单系统的动力学。

examples.text_en: The old dynamo still works after many long years.
examples.text_zh: 这台旧发电机用了许多年还能运转。

examples.text_en: A small dynamo can make power for the house.
examples.text_zh: 一台小发电机就能为这所房子供电。

examples.text_en: The whole office was a dysfunctional place to work.
examples.text_zh: 整个办公室都处于一种运转失灵的状态。

examples.text_en: They came from a dysfunctional family and felt lost.
examples.text_zh: 他们来自一个功能失调的家庭，感到迷茫。

examples.text_en: The child has dyslexia and finds reading hard.
examples.text_zh: 这孩子有阅读障碍，觉得读书很难。

examples.text_en: His dyslexia made school a hard place for years.
examples.text_zh: 阅读困难让他在学校里苦了好些年。

examples.text_en: The dyspeptic old man could not enjoy his food.
examples.text_zh: 这位消化不良的老人无法好好享用食物。

examples.text_en: She felt dyspeptic after she ate too much food.
examples.text_zh: 她吃得太饱，觉得消化不良。

examples.text_en: The eaglet waited in its home for the mother.
examples.text_zh: 小鹰在巢里等着母鹰回来。

examples.text_en: A small eaglet was born on the high land.
examples.text_zh: 一只小鹰在高地上出生了。

examples.text_en: Please stay within earshot of the small group.
examples.text_zh: 请待在这群人能听到的范围内。

examples.text_en: She was out of earshot and heard nothing.
examples.text_zh: 她在听不到声音的地方，什么也没听见。

examples.text_en: An earsplitting sound came from the big room.
examples.text_zh: 一阵震耳欲聋的声音从大房间里传来。

examples.text_en: The music was earsplitting and we left soon after.
examples.text_zh: 音乐震耳欲聋，我们很快就离开了。

examples.text_en: The old woman kept water in fine earthenware.
examples.text_zh: 老妇人用精美的陶器盛水。

examples.text_en: They found earthenware under the ground near the house.
examples.text_zh: 他们在房子附近的地下发现了陶器。

examples.text_en: The news was earthshaking for the whole small town.
examples.text_zh: 这个消息对整个小镇来说都是惊天动地的。

examples.text_en: It was an earthshaking change in their long history.
examples.text_zh: 这是他们漫长历史中一次惊天动地的变化。

examples.text_en: Her words were simple and earthy and very true.
examples.text_zh: 她的话朴实自然，非常真实。

examples.text_en: The earthy road led us to the old house.
examples.text_zh: 这条土路把我们引向那座老房子。

examples.text_en: He put the picture on a simple easel.
examples.text_zh: 他把画放到一个简单的画架上。

examples.text_en: A small easel stood near the open door.
examples.text_zh: 一个画架立在一扇敞开的门边。

examples.text_en: The water runs eastward through the whole town.
examples.text_zh: 河水向东流经整个小镇。

examples.text_en: They walked eastward for a long and hard day.
examples.text_zh: 他们向东走了整整一天，又累又辛苦。

examples.text_en: The group moved eastwards over the green land.
examples.text_zh: 这群人向东越过绿色的土地。

examples.text_en: We turned eastwards at the end of the road.
examples.text_zh: 我们在路的尽头转向东方。

examples.text_en: We watched the ebb from the high wall.
examples.text_zh: 我们从高墙上看着退潮。

examples.text_en: Their hope began to ebb after the long year.
examples.text_zh: 漫长的一年过去后，他们的希望开始消退。

examples.text_en: Her ebullience made the whole party feel young again.
examples.text_zh: 她的热情让整个聚会的人都感到年轻了。

examples.text_en: He met us with the ebullience of a small boy.
examples.text_zh: 他像个小男孩一样兴高采烈地迎接我们。

examples.text_en: His eccentricity was known to everyone in the town.
examples.text_zh: 他的怪癖镇上的每个人都知道。

examples.text_en: We soon got used to all his eccentricity.
examples.text_zh: 我们很快就习惯了他所有的怪癖。

examples.text_en: Ecdysis helps the young one change in water.
examples.text_zh: 蜕皮帮助幼体在水中发生变化。

examples.text_en: We learned about ecdysis in the science class.
examples.text_zh: 我们在科学课上学习了蜕皮。

examples.text_en: The show was a great eclat for the young group.
examples.text_zh: 这场演出让这个年轻团体大获成功。

examples.text_en: Her work was done with eclat and great care.
examples.text_zh: 她的工作完成得十分出色，备受称赞。

examples.text_en: He is an eclectic and reads many kinds of books.
examples.text_zh: 他是个折衷主义者，什么书都读。

examples.text_en: The eclectic took ideas from every school of thought.
examples.text_zh: 这位折衷主义者从各种思想流派中汲取观点。

examples.text_en: His eclecticism made his work very different.
examples.text_zh: 他的折衷主义让他的作品显得与众不同。

examples.text_en: The teacher spoke about eclecticism in modern art.
examples.text_zh: 老师讲了现代艺术中的折衷主义。

examples.text_en: He wrote an eclogue about the simple country life.
examples.text_zh: 他写了一首关于简朴乡村生活的牧歌。

examples.text_en: This eclogue tells of the fields and the sea.
examples.text_zh: 这首牧歌描写了田野和大海。

examples.text_en: The group studies the ecological health of the land.
examples.text_zh: 这个小组研究这片土地的生态健康。

examples.text_en: We must think about the ecological cost of this plan.
examples.text_zh: 我们必须考虑这个计划的生态代价。

examples.text_en: The ecologist works on the health of the land.
examples.text_zh: 这位生态学家研究这片土地的健康状况。

examples.text_en: A young ecologist came to our team last month.
examples.text_zh: 一位年轻的生态学家上个月加入了我们的团队。

examples.text_en: The small company must work economically this year.
examples.text_zh: 这家小公司今年必须节约地运营。

examples.text_en: The country is not economically strong just now.
examples.text_zh: 这个国家目前在经济上并不强大。

examples.text_en: We must economize on water and power this summer.
examples.text_zh: 今年夏天我们必须在水和电上节约。

examples.text_en: They had to economize after the loss of work.
examples.text_zh: 失去工作后，他们不得不省吃俭用。

examples.text_en: The whole ecosystem depends on the health of water.
examples.text_zh: 整个生态系统都依赖水的状况。

examples.text_en: A small fire can change the ecosystem of the area.
examples.text_zh: 一场小火就能改变这个地区的生态系统。

examples.text_en: She was in ecstasy when she heard the good news.
examples.text_zh: 听到这个好消息时，她欣喜若狂。

examples.text_en: The music filled him with ecstasy for a while.
examples.text_zh: 音乐让他一时陶醉其中。

examples.text_en: The ecstatic ran home to tell everyone the news.
examples.text_zh: 这个欣喜若狂的人跑回家把消息告诉大家。

examples.text_en: She was an ecstatic after the great win.
examples.text_zh: 大获全胜之后，她成了一个狂喜的人。

examples.text_en: They held an ecumenical meeting for the whole town.
examples.text_zh: 他们为全镇举行了一次联合的会议。

examples.text_en: The idea had an ecumenical and very open form.
examples.text_zh: 这个想法具有普世而开放的形态。

examples.text_en: A small eddy formed in the water near us.
examples.text_zh: 我们附近的水中形成了一个小漩涡。

examples.text_en: The man was lost in a strong eddy.
examples.text_zh: 那个人被卷进了一个强劲的漩涡。

examples.text_en: The edentate one has no teeth and cannot eat.
examples.text_zh: 这种无齿的动物没有牙齿，无法进食。

examples.text_en: An edentate mouth has no teeth for the food.
examples.text_zh: 无齿的嘴里没有牙齿来咀嚼食物。

examples.text_en: The king sent an edict to every town.
examples.text_zh: 国王向每个城镇颁布了一道法令。

examples.text_en: A new edict changed the rules for the market.
examples.text_zh: 一道新法令改变了市场的规则。

examples.text_en: The great edifice could be seen from the sea.
examples.text_zh: 从海上可以看到那座宏伟的大厦。

examples.text_en: They built a huge edifice near the city center.
examples.text_zh: 他们在市中心附近建了一座巨大的建筑。

examples.text_en: The old teacher tried to edify the young people.
examples.text_zh: 这位老教师努力启迪年轻人。

examples.text_en: Good books can edify and help us in life.
examples.text_zh: 好书能在生活中启迪和帮助我们。

examples.text_en: The teacher believed that every child is educable.
examples.text_zh: 这位老师相信每个孩子都是可教育的。

examples.text_en: They found the young boy educable and full of hope.
examples.text_zh: 他们发现这个小男孩可教，而且充满希望。

examples.text_en: Her parents worked hard to educate their children.
examples.text_zh: 她的父母辛勤工作，供孩子们读书。

examples.text_en: We must educate young people about the real world.
examples.text_zh: 我们必须让年轻人了解真实的世界。

examples.text_en: The teacher tried to educe the answer from us.
examples.text_zh: 老师设法从我们这里引出答案。

examples.text_en: We can educe the truth from these few words.
examples.text_zh: 我们可以从这几句话里推断出真相。

examples.text_en: An eerie sound came from the dark old house.
examples.text_zh: 从黑暗的老房子里传来一阵诡异的声音。

examples.text_en: The dark street felt eerie at that late hour.
examples.text_zh: 那条漆黑的街道在那个深夜显得格外阴森。

examples.text_en: Time can efface the pain of those old days.
examples.text_zh: 时间可以抹去那些旧日的伤痛。

examples.text_en: He tried to efface his name from the book.
examples.text_zh: 他设法把自己的名字从书上抹去。

examples.text_en: The new plan worked effectively and saved much money.
examples.text_zh: 新计划很有效，省下了不少钱。

examples.text_en: She can speak effectively in front of a big group.
examples.text_zh: 她能在一大群人面前有效地讲话。

examples.text_en: We tested the effectiveness of the new plan.
examples.text_zh: 我们检验了这个新方案的效力。

examples.text_en: The effectiveness of the plan was never in question.
examples.text_zh: 这个方案的效果从未受到怀疑。

examples.text_en: They called him effeminate because of his soft voice.
examples.text_zh: 因为他嗓音轻柔，他们说他女人气。

examples.text_en: He had an effeminate face and a light voice.
examples.text_zh: 他面容柔和，声音也轻柔。

examples.text_en: The water began to effervesce in the cold cup.
examples.text_zh: 水在冰冷的杯子里开始冒泡。

examples.text_en: The children effervesce with fun at every party.
examples.text_zh: 孩子们在每次聚会上都兴奋地闹个不停。

examples.text_en: The old land became effete after years of use.
examples.text_zh: 多年耕种之后，这片老土地变得贫瘠。

examples.text_en: Their effete system could not meet the new needs.
examples.text_zh: 他们衰败的体制无法满足新的需要。

examples.text_en: The old way was efficacious and very easy to use.
examples.text_zh: 这个老办法很有效，而且用起来很容易。

examples.text_en: They found a simple and efficacious answer to the problem.
examples.text_zh: 他们找到了一个简单有效的解决办法。

examples.text_en: They questioned the efficacy of the old plan.
examples.text_zh: 他们质疑这个老方案的功效。

examples.text_en: The test showed the efficacy of the new way.
examples.text_zh: 试验显示了新方法的效力。

examples.text_en: They made an effigy of the old king.
examples.text_zh: 他们做了一个老国王的雕像。

examples.text_en: The effigy stood near the door of the house.
examples.text_zh: 那尊肖像立在这所房子的门边。

examples.text_en: The effluent water ran into the small sea.
examples.text_zh: 流出的水排进了不远处的大海。

examples.text_en: Effluent waste from the works must be tested.
examples.text_zh: 工厂排出的废水必须接受检测。

examples.text_en: The effluvia from the old water made us leave.
examples.text_zh: 从旧水里散出的臭气让我们离开了。

examples.text_en: The effluvia filled the room and we went out.
examples.text_zh: 臭气充满了房间，我们只好出去。

examples.text_en: He had the effrontery to ask for more money.
examples.text_zh: 他竟厚颜无耻地要更多的钱。

examples.text_en: Her effrontery surprised everyone at the meeting.
examples.text_zh: 她的厚颜无耻让会上的每个人都吃惊。

examples.text_en: The effulgent light filled the whole room.
examples.text_zh: 灿烂的光芒充满了整个房间。

examples.text_en: Her effulgent smile made the day seem good.
examples.text_zh: 她灿烂的笑容让这一天变得美好。

examples.text_en: They held egalitarian ideas about work and money.
examples.text_zh: 他们在工作和金钱上抱着平等主义的想法。

examples.text_en: The group had an egalitarian way of making decisions.
examples.text_zh: 这个团体做事讲究平等。

examples.text_en: The eggshell broke in his hand and fell down.
examples.text_zh: 蛋壳在他手里碎了，掉了下来。

examples.text_en: She put the eggshell pieces into the dustbin.
examples.text_zh: 她把蛋壳碎片丢进了垃圾箱。

examples.text_en: The egocentric man talked only about his own work.
examples.text_zh: 这个自我中心的人只谈自己的工作。

examples.text_en: She found him egocentric and hard to be with.
examples.text_zh: 她觉得他只顾自己，很难相处。

examples.text_en: His egoism made it hard for him to help others.
examples.text_zh: 他的利己主义使他很难去帮助别人。

examples.text_en: The book tells of egoism and the common good.
examples.text_zh: 这本书讲的是利己主义与共同利益。

examples.text_en: The egotist could talk about nothing but himself.
examples.text_zh: 这个自我中心者除了自己什么都谈不了。

examples.text_en: He was a real egotist and never asked about us.
examples.text_zh: 他是个十足的自我中心者，从不问起我们。

examples.text_en: It was an egregious waste of our time.
examples.text_zh: 这简直是对我们时间的极大浪费。

examples.text_en: They made an egregious error in the final report.
examples.text_zh: 他们在最终报告里犯了一个极其严重的错误。

examples.text_en: The only egress from the room was a small door.
examples.text_zh: 这个房间唯一的出口是一扇小门。

examples.text_en: They found another egress at the back of the house.
examples.text_zh: 他们在房子后面找到了另一个出口。

examples.text_en: He would ejaculate a few words and then stop.
examples.text_zh: 他会突然冒出几句话，然后就不说了。

examples.text_en: She would ejaculate a word of thanks and smile.
examples.text_zh: 她会突然说一句感谢的话，然后微笑。

examples.text_en: The machine can eject the old card in a moment.
examples.text_zh: 这台机器能很快弹出旧卡片。

examples.text_en: They had to eject him from the club that night.
examples.text_zh: 那天晚上他们不得不把他逐出俱乐部。

examples.text_en: The room was elaborately made and full of light.
examples.text_zh: 这个房间做得十分精巧，光线充足。

examples.text_en: She told the story elaborately and with great care.
examples.text_zh: 她非常细致地讲了这件事。

examples.text_en: The plan needs no further elaboration from us.
examples.text_zh: 这个计划不需要我们再作进一步的阐述。

examples.text_en: His elaboration of the idea took the whole morning.
examples.text_zh: 他详细阐述这个想法花了一上午。

examples.text_en: Many years will elapse before we meet again.
examples.text_zh: 要过很多年我们才会再见面。

examples.text_en: A long time had to elapse before the answer came.
examples.text_zh: 过了很久答案才来。

examples.text_en: The elastic in his old shoes had gone bad.
examples.text_zh: 他旧鞋上的松紧带已经坏了。

examples.text_en: She used a long elastic to hold the box.
examples.text_zh: 她用一根长橡皮筋把盒子捆住。

examples.text_en: This old elastic has lost its elasticity.
examples.text_zh: 这根旧橡皮筋已经失去弹性了。

examples.text_en: We tested the elasticity of the new line.
examples.text_zh: 我们测试了新线的弹性。

examples.text_en: He could not hide his elation at the news.
examples.text_zh: 听到这个消息，他无法掩饰自己的得意。

examples.text_en: The whole team was full of elation that night.
examples.text_zh: 那天晚上整个团队都兴高采烈。

examples.text_en: The electorate will decide the future of the country.
examples.text_zh: 选民将决定这个国家的未来。

examples.text_en: A small part of the electorate came to vote.
examples.text_zh: 只有一小部分选民来投票。

examples.text_en: The electrode must be kept in a safe place.
examples.text_zh: 电极必须放在安全的地方。

examples.text_en: He put a new electrode into the old machine.
examples.text_zh: 他把一个新电极装进了那台旧机器。

examples.text_en: The electromagnetic force holds the small parts together.
examples.text_zh: 电磁力把这些小部件聚在一起。

examples.text_en: They study electromagnetic waves in the science class.
examples.text_zh: 他们在科学课上研究电磁波。

examples.text_en: An electron is much smaller than the whole atom.
examples.text_zh: 一个电子比整个原子小得多。

examples.text_en: The electron moves around the center of the atom.
examples.text_zh: 电子围绕原子的中心运动。
